module: LuaJIT's jit.zone module (Mike Pall, MIT license): hierarchical stack of named "zones", used by the LuaJIT profiler to label portions of code. The module returns a callable table: zone("name") pushes a zone, zone() pops one and returns it. A modder normally does not need it.
usage:
local zone = require("jit.zone")
zone("AI")
  print(zone:get()) --> "AI"
zone()
notes: zone() with no argument pops; on an empty stack, assert fails with "empty zone stack".

get.desc: Returns the current zone, i.e. the top of the stack (zone:get()), or nil if empty.
